newsitem.title: USA: Federal-Mogul to redeem some pfd stock.
newsitem.headline: Federal-Mogul to redeem some pfd stock.

text.p: Federal-Mogul Corp said Friday it will redeem all of its outstanding $3.875 Series D Convertible Exchangeable Preferred Stock on August 28, 1997.

Under terms of the redemption, holders of preferred stock not previously converted to common stock will receive about $19.68 for each share redeemed (which includes accrued dividends through the redemption date.)
Each share of preferred stock is convertible into 2.778 shares of common stock on August 21, 1997, at which time the right to convert will expire.
Federal-Mogul makes and distributes parts for automobiles, light trucks, heavy trucks, and farm and construction vehicles.
Shares of Federal-Mogul closed off 11/16 to 35-9/16.
